label: rem:big-bang-state-remark
title: Constituents and jet data of a big bang state
html: Equivalently, every constituent of a big bang state \mathcal{S}_0 satisfies H_i = \varnothing (a photon with zero fibre data), and the section s_0 \in \Gamma(U, A_0) encoding their identity vanishes. There are no degree-0 observables at \mathcal{S}_0. The remaining higher-jet data—sections of A_1/A_0 (linear transport) and A_2/A_0 (curvature)—provides the seed for the forward light cone \mathcal{S}_1, \mathcal{S}_2, \ldots
heading: Remark
